0022600194.text: The Rockets (7-2) are headed into their 10th game of the season, sitting first in the Southwest and third in the West, with a 4-1 home record and a 3-1 road mark, after a loss in their most recent game. The Suns (1-5) have dropped four straight, are 1-2 at home and 0-3 on the road, and sit third in the Pacific, 4.5 games back, while Houston swept the 2025-26 season series 4-0 and won the last meeting 119-105 in Phoenix on April 7, 2026, with no games yet in the 2026-27 series. Houston is without Steven Adams (out, calf strain) and has Clint Capela listed as day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision, while Phoenix is missing Jordan Goodwin (out, calf), Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (out, ankle sprain).
